title: Title & Registration Services Late-Penalty Reimbursement: Addition for a Long Wait Since First Submission
content:
On a Title & Registration Services late-penalty reimbursement, the reimbursed share is raised by one tenth (0.10) when more than forty-five calendar days have passed from the first submission date to the day of reimbursement, by one twentieth (0.05) when twenty-one to forty-five days have, and by nothing otherwise. The share as raised never exceeds one; the reimbursement is the reimbursable penalty multiplied by it and rounded half up to the cent only at the end.

The first submission date is the date the order's title fee was remitted to the state.

| Calendar days from first submission to the day of reimbursement | Addition to the reimbursed share |
|---|---|
| more than 45 | 0.10 |
| 21 to 45 | 0.05 |
| 20 or fewer | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, first submission 1 March)

| Day of reimbursement | Days passed | Addition |
|---|---|---|
| 21 March | 20 | nothing |
| 22 March | 21 | 0.05 |
| 15 April | 45 | 0.05 |
| 16 April | 46 | 0.10 |

Hypothetical illustration: a share of 0.95 raised by 0.10 would be 1.05; it is held at one.
